title: CLO Auto Batch Renderer
content:
**Auto Batch Renderer** — a plug-in designed to streamline the CLO3D workflow when handling multiple projects. This tool automates batch rendering to help save time and improve efficiency.

Key Features:

  * Batch project import: Import multiple .zprj project files simultaneously.

  * Colorway selection: Easily choose which colorways to include in your batch render.

  * Customizable render settings: Use your project’s default settings or apply custom render, camera, lighting, and quality settings.

  * Custom views: Define specific camera angles to showcase your designs from different perspectives.

  * Flexible settings: Apply settings globally or customize them individually for each project or even for each colorway.

  * Render logging: Every time you press render, every action is logged for better tracking and troubleshooting.

If you are interested to test it write me a.rossato@prisma-tech.it

title: Unused pattern piece can not be deleted
content:
Hello,

In my recent project, I assigned fabric A for all pattern pieces. After I replaced them all by fabric B. As usual when all the pattern pieces has been assigned by other fabric, the old one could be deleted, but in my case, fabric A remains. I figured out that there is ONE piece that if delete it, fabric A will also delatable. Could someone please help me to explain why this is happening? How could I delete fabric A without deleting that pattern piece?

I'm looking for your help!![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202506/c3358d8cec9e4dd4a44b63ee9ad91b24/images/d8ce3584132d456cb1a2f91e635126c8z6689596605002_6be9f0a81e2189af466377587860da4c.jpg)![01c8d6e86797481abbf3d4d64ec62dbe](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202506/c3358d8cec9e4dd4a44b63ee9ad91b24/images/01c8d6e86797481abbf3d4d64ec62dbeimage.png)![8d012d4a826142aca75160711c38c216](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202506/c3358d8cec9e4dd4a44b63ee9ad91b24/images/8d012d4a826142aca75160711c38c216z6689596605002_6be9f0a81e2189af466377587860da4c.jpg)


### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Hello, thanks for your reply. I've check on that pattern, but the thing is, that pattern piece was duplicated using filler, why don't both of 2 piece stored the same fabric data? Additionally, there's no internal line or topstitch... to be assigned.

Comment 2: Maybe itrelates to how fabric assignment metadata is stored in pattern pieces.Fabric A is still assigned somewhere in that single pattern piece — likely in a hidden or non-obvious way. Here are the possible causes:1.Fabric Assigned to the Back Side Only:In CLO/MD, pattern pieces have both Front and Back sides. Even if you assign Fabric B to the Front, the Back might still be using Fabric A.You can check this in the Property Editor > Fabric > Side > Back.2.Fabric Assigned to Internal Lines or Bindings:If there are internal lines (for piping, topstitching, etc.) or binding/edge finishes, they can retain the old fabric.These details may not be visible unless explicitly selected.3.Fabric Assigned to a Graphic or Topstitching Element:Sometimes textures or stitching details retain fabric links independently.
Reply 1: Hello, jumping in to clear up that point 1 and 3 are incorrect and impossible. Point 2 made is correct and could be a cause.
content_description: "Seek advice on resolving a fabric assignment issue in pattern design, specifically how to delete an old fabric without affecting a specific pattern piece."

title: CLO/MD LiveSync is on Fab — Now with macOS Support!
content:
We are thrilled to announce that [**CLO/MD LiveSync is now available on Fab.com**](https://www.fab.com/listings/e1ecc882-d6c4-4928-b880-5f66d1590bba)! This means you'll be able to download LiveSync and update to newer versions directly through the Epic Games Launcher, without needing to manually place the plugin in the engine folder. **With this update, you can now use CLO/MD LiveSync on macOS as well**! 🚀

You can get it by navigating to the listing and clicking 'Add to My Library' after signing in. Then, you can find it by searching for 'LiveSync' in Library > Fab Library on the Epic Games Launcher. **Please note that this is available for Unreal Engine 5.6 and later versions**.

![7d66e68daab7461cb7e370a02585d8aa](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202506/c68de71f63fa47bb9464917bc07a9e95/images/7d66e68daab7461cb7e370a02585d8aaUntitled-1.jpg)

![b398547db6eb47a09ac0f246b434e2dc](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202506/c68de71f63fa47bb9464917bc07a9e95/images/b398547db6eb47a09ac0f246b434e2dcimage.png)

We are currently working on supporting the new MetaHuman Parametric Body in both CLO and Marvelous Designer, as well as creating a series of tutorial videos for using CLO/MD LiveSync (check out [**the latest updates for MetaHuman in Unreal Engine 5.6**](https://www.metahuman.com/en-US/news/metahuman-leaves-early-access-with-a-feature-packed-new-release)). In the meantime, please refer to [**the existing documentation for LiveSync 2**](https://connect-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/sections/45247124078873-User-guide-for-LiveSync-2). Stay tuned for more updates! 🙂

Best regards,

Bryan![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202506/c68de71f63fa47bb9464917bc07a9e95/images/8a95bc78dd2a491891621e1cc855274fCLO_LiveSyncPromo_Still_No_Title_Expand.png)
